title: Rights & Official Helplines
subtitle: Plain-language verified guidance for Indian consumers. General informational starting points, not legal advice. Always check official government portals.
decisionTreeDesc: Answer 2 quick factual questions to find whether company escalation, NCH 1915, RBI Ombudsman, or e-Jagriti is appropriate.
q1: Question 1: Have you already lodged a formal complaint with the company's customer care?
q1Yes: Yes, I lodged a ticket and have a reference / ticket number
q1No: No, I haven't contacted them yet
q2: Question 2: What is the current status of the dispute?
q2SellerRejected: Seller rejected return, item defective, or no reply for 4+ days
q2UpiFailed: Seller claims refund was sent via UPI, but money not received
q2HighValue: High-value claim (over ₹20,000) where NCH failed to resolve
notYetVerified: Not yet verified: open the official site to confirm
